svg.title: Electric field of two opposite charges
svg.desc: A map of the electric field around two equal and opposite point charges, the positive one on the left and the negative one on the right. Curved field lines leave the positive charge in every direction and curve round to arrive at the negative charge, each carrying one arrowhead showing which way the field points. Separate straight arrows at sample points show the field vector there: longer where the field is stronger, and always tangent to the line through that point. The lines are packed closely near the charges, where the field is strong, and spread far apart at the edges, where it is weak. No two lines ever cross, because the field has only one direction at each point. Illustrative data.
svg.text: arrows are sample field vectors; grey curves are field lines
Lines leave the positive charge and arrive at the negative one
Lines never cross: the field has one direction at each point.
